methods.label: Evaluate from the inside outward
methods.explanation:
Work from the innermost absolute value outward. An absolute value leaves a nonnegative number unchanged and replaces a negative number with its opposite. Since \(x=-2016\), we have \(|x|=2016\), so
\[
\bigl||x|-x\bigr|=|2016-(-2016)|=4032.
\]
The full expression is therefore
\[
|4032-2016|-(-2016)
=2016+2016
=4032.
\]
The answer is \(4032\), choice D.
